summaries.Romania: Romania's political crisis appears to be resolving as PSD enters government under PM Luca Niculescu with 11 ministers, while PNL agrees to vote for investiture without joining the coalition. Attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea continue to dominate security concerns, with NATO considering stronger responses and Romania coordinating defense measures with Bulgaria.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare AI and automation are accelerating across diagnostics, prior authorization, and operational workflows, while workforce challenges persist despite new initiatives like Walmart's expanded benefits and telehealth integration. Policy shifts under the Trump administration are affecting FDA staffing and drug import regulations, creating uncertainty for the industry.
summaries.Tech: Apple's ecosystem expanded significantly with the iPhone Duo foldable ($1,999+), HomeView smart hub, and HomePod mini 2 featuring Siri AI, while the company approaches $5 trillion market cap. Meanwhile, security concerns mount around AI-powered surveillance, Starlink restrictions in Ukraine affecting military operations, and rising regulatory scrutiny of tech giants from OpenAI to Amazon.

items.title: Decizia PSD: intră în Guvernul Luca Niculescu. Sorin Grindeanu s-a abținut la vot. Social-democrații vor avea 11 ministere (surse)

items.line: PSD's entry into government with 11 ministries and PNL's conditional support resolves months of political gridlock and provides Romania with executive stability.
